_comment: Scout golden set (hand-labelled ground truth) for api/scripts/score_scout.py. The notices are the SYNTHETIC seed notices in data/seed_tenders/ (fictional). Scored fields: deadline (BS ISO date, and AD datetime in NPT to the minute), estimated_cost_npr (integer NPR, null = the notice has no unambiguous cost), required_doc_types (set of schemas.enums.DocType). An entry with status 'todo' is not labelled yet and is skipped; fill it in and set status 'filled'.

labelling_rules.deadline: The bid SUBMISSION deadline, not publication, document purchase or opening. A corrigendum's new deadline. A date-only deadline is 23:59:59 NPT. null if the notice gives no computable date.
labelling_rules.estimated_cost_npr: The cost estimate as the notice states it. null when it is absent or ambiguous (e.g. an 'in thousands' table cell that contradicts the words, or digits that contradict the amount in words).
labelling_rules.required_doc_types: Documents the bidder must submit or must hold (a licence the bidder 'must have' counts), including conditional ones (JV agreement if the notice demands it from JV bidders). Bid security counts when the notice demands one. 'tax clearance or tax return' is tax_clearance only (the Rule 40(2)(d) alternative). Evidence implied only by a criterion (turnover, experience) is NOT listed unless the notice names the document. Any non-standard document (payment voucher, ISO certificate, vehicle bluebook) is 'other'. Order does not matter.
labelling_rules.tax_clearance_fy: Informational, not scored yet: the fiscal year the tax clearance must cover.

tenders.notes: Mixed EN/NE. BS and AD in one string. 'other' = the bid-document fee payment voucher. Licence must be renewed for F/Y 2083/84.
English. Cost in crore. '12:00 noon'. Liquid assets / turnover / experience are criteria, not named documents.
ICB goods, AD-only deadline (BS is the lookup-table conversion). 'other' = manufacturer's authorization and ISO 13485 / CE / FDA certificates.
Nepali with an English line. Cost is a table cell 'रु. हजारमा' (4,850 thousand) while the prose says 'about fifty lakh': ambiguous, so null. Licence: 'घ' class or above must be held.
All-Nepali sealed quotation, Devanagari digits and danda separators. 'other' = vehicle bluebook, insurance and fitness test copies. Bid security = धरौटी voucher or bank guarantee.
